title.en: Chapter 22 — Little Men on the Paper

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: زبون جاب ورقة عليها رسمات رجال بيرقصوا.
sentences.en: A client brought a paper with drawings of dancing men.
He said: my wife saw it and fainted.

sentences.ar: قال: هي أمريكية، وقبل الجواز طلبت مني إشي واحد.
sentences.en: He said: she is American, and before the marriage she asked me one thing.

sentences.ar: إني ما أسألها أبداً عن حياتها قبل ما تعرفني.
sentences.en: That I never ask her about her life before she knew me.
Holmes looked at the drawings a long time.

sentences.ar: قال: هاي مش رسمات ولاد. هاي كتابة.
sentences.en: He said: these are not children’s drawings. This is writing.
